decisions.reason: A certified HVAC plate heat exchanger close to the core offer costs little to keep listed, and its value is still uncertain only one year after launch, so the option is worth holding.
The marine box cooler already reports a major market share in water cooling systems, signaling realized value that justifies continued commitment.
The marine cooling unit has a dedicated page and complements the marine portfolio at low carrying cost while its uncertainty resolves.
The compact oil cooler is only mentioned and has no results yet, but it builds on existing capabilities and costs little to keep, so dropping it now would forfeit an unresolved option.
Finned tubes for air coolers are a component-level extension with its own page, and the low incremental cost justifies waiting for market feedback.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes leverage in-house R&D and share production with existing lines, so keeping them is cheap while their value is still uncertain.
